observed_value: Stored bdc_investment_identifier includes schedule headings such as 'Debt Investments Business Services' or 'Equity and Other Investments Business Services' before the actual issuer and instrument.
anchor_value: Raw schedule keeps those labels as separate classification heading rows; the position row begins with the issuer and investment only.

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Artisan Topco LP (8) | Class A Preferred Units ( 7,882,736 units) | 11/7/2023 | 7,883 | 6,622 | 0.2 | %

findings.detail: Debt investment identifiers are polluted by separate asset-class and sector headings; the raw Lynx BidCo row starts with issuer plus instrument, not 'Debt Investments Business Services'.
Equity identifiers are polluted by separate asset-class and sector headings; the raw Artisan Topco row starts with issuer plus instrument, not 'Equity and Other Investments Business Services'.

rationale: PP01 flags position-purity candidates in bdc_investment_identifier. The raw source schedule separates classification labels from position rows: for example, table 8 has 'Debt Investments' and 'Business Services' as heading rows, while table 8 row 18 is only Lynx BidCo plus its first-lien loan terms; table 11 similarly has 'Equity and Other Investments' and 'Business Services' headings, while row 6 is only Artisan Topco LP plus preferred-unit terms. The stored flagged values concatenate those headings into the identifier, so the identifier contains classification context that is not part of the source position name. This is a localized extraction/normalization defect, not a subtotal row or false alarm.
